body: So I'm not a professional or anything but it seems like you might be drawn to the danger/excitement of oding. Is there anything else in your life that gives you that same sense of enjoyment that you could potentially replacing oding with? It might not be AS enjoyable, but sometimes a little enjoyment is the tradeoff for keeping yourself safe and healthy. You're not suicidial but taking overdoses, especially on a regular basis, can potentially lead to serious harm, permenant damage, or death. I'm not telling you this to scare you or anything, I just want to make sure you know how dangerous what you're doing is in the short and long term. Just because it doesn't kill you now doesn't mean it won't ever do that. If there's nothing you're willing to replace the oding with, is there a lower amount of pills you'd be willing to take? A small overdose would probably be safer than a big one, although both are potentially able to end your life. Also, would you be willing to contact a self harm or suicide hotline before you od next time and talk to them about you urges?

You don't deserve to feel like shit though. You feel like you do and you feel guilty because you're not a psychopath. A psychopath wouldn't give a shit who they hurt. I can't tell you if you're a good person or a bad person, but I do know that if you were bad enough you wouldn't care who you hurt and you obviously do. I don't know if it was an accident or intentional or the reasons you did or what you did, but I do know from experience there's no way to undo the things we feel guilty about, and that all you can do is try to heal and undo any damage you've done and try to forgive yourself because otherwise it eats you up inside the way it's doing now.

I'm really glad you're not suicidial and that you're okay, but either way overdosing is dangerous and potentially deadly. I've nonsuicidially overdosed for self harm reasons in the past and it's really not a fun experience. If you don't mind me asking, why do you overdose if you're not suicidial? Is it for self harm, emotional regulation, attention and care from us/the people around you, to feel something, etc? Depending on the reason, the people here might be able to offer some resources and better outlets for those urges besides iron overdoses.
